rules: Official organizer evidence is preferred; calendar listings are marked secondary/unconfirmed where no organizer confirmation was found.
A download button or ZIP link is not binary GPX validation.
Do not delete, overwrite or replace historical GPX files until a new official file has been downloaded, extracted, parsed and validated.
No live event records or app runtime files are changed in this audit.
